examples.en: It's a bright and sunny day.
We had sunny weather all week.

mnemonic.tip: sun(太阳)+ny,满是太阳的天气就是晴天。

examples.en: The sky is cloudy this morning.
It may rain because it's so cloudy.

mnemonic.tip: cloud(云)+y,满天是云就是多云。

examples.en: It's too windy to fly a kite.
examples.zh: 风太大了不适合放风筝。

examples.en: A windy day blew my hat off.
examples.zh: 刮风的天把我帽子吹跑了。

mnemonic.tip: wind(风)+y,风呼呼地刮就是 windy。

examples.en: We played outside on the snowy morning.
examples.zh: 在这个下雪的早晨我们在外面玩。

examples.en: The mountains look beautiful and snowy.

mnemonic.tip: snow(雪)+y,到处是雪就是 snowy。

examples.en: It was foggy and hard to see.
Drive slowly on foggy roads.

mnemonic.tip: fog(雾)+g+y,一团雾罩着就是 foggy。

examples.en: The sea is stormy today.
We stayed inside on the stormy night.
examples.zh: 暴风雨的夜里我们待在屋内。

mnemonic.tip: storm(暴风雨)+y,狂风暴雨的天气就是 stormy。

examples.en: The temperature dropped last night.
What's the temperature today?

mnemonic.tip: temper(调和/冷热)+ature,天气冷热的度数就是温度。

examples.en: The weather forecast says it will rain.
Check the forecast before you go.

mnemonic.tip: fore(预先)+cast(投掷/抛),提前把天气"抛"出来告诉你就是预报。

examples.en: This country has a warm climate.
The climate is changing.

mnemonic.tip: weather 是某天的天气,climate 是一地长年的"大天气"=气候。

examples.en: The thunder woke the baby.
We heard thunder in the distance.

mnemonic.tip: thunder 谐音"闪的"——先闪电后"轰"的一声雷。

examples.en: Lightning lit up the sky.
Don't stand under a tree in lightning.

mnemonic.tip: light(光)+ning,天上突然亮起的强光就是闪电。

examples.en: There was a light shower this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午下了一阵小雨。

examples.en: I take a shower every morning.

mnemonic.tip: shower 既是"淋浴"又是"阵雨"——天空像开了淋浴,下一阵就停。

examples.en: A cool breeze came from the sea.
examples.zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从海上吹来。

examples.en: The breeze moved the curtains.

mnemonic.tip: breeze 谐音"卜瑞子"——轻轻的"呼~"一阵就是微风。

examples.en: There was frost on the grass this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上草地上结了霜。

examples.en: The frost killed the flowers.

mnemonic.tip: frost 里有 fro(冷,同 freeze/frozen),冷到地面结的白结晶就是霜。

examples.en: Water freezes at zero degrees.
My hands froze in the cold.

mnemonic.tip: freeze 谐音"福瑞子"——冷到"哆嗦"结成冰(过去式 froze)。

examples.en: The snow melts in spring.
The ice cream melted quickly.

mnemonic.tip: melt 谐音"没了它"——太阳一晒,雪化了"没了它"就是融化。

examples.en: Summers here are hot and humid.
The air felt humid before the rain.

mnemonic.tip: humid 谐音"回米的"——梅雨天潮得连米都"回潮",就是潮湿。

examples.en: The weather is dry in autumn.
Keep the clothes in a dry place.
examples.zh: 把衣服放在干燥的地方。

mnemonic.tip: dry 谐音"拽"——太干了嗓子发"拽"、皮肤发紧就是干燥。

examples.en: The ground is wet after the rain.
Take an umbrella; it's wet outside.

mnemonic.tip: wet 谐音"喂特"——被雨"喂"了一身水就是湿。

examples.en: It gets chilly in the evening.
Wear a coat; it's chilly today.

mnemonic.tip: chilly 谐音"齐力"——冷得直打"激灵",微冷就是 chilly。

examples.en: The winter was quite mild this year.
We enjoyed the mild spring weather.
examples.zh: 我们享受着温和的春日天气。

mnemonic.tip: mild 谐音"迈欧德"——不冷不热、温温和和就是 mild。

examples.en: It's freezing outside today.
My feet are freezing.

mnemonic.tip: freeze(结冰)+ing,冷到能把人冻成冰就是 freezing。

examples.en: It was boiling hot at noon.
examples.zh: 中午热得像要煮开一样。

examples.en: The beach is boiling in July.

mnemonic.tip: boil(煮沸)+ing,热到像开水一样就是酷热。

examples.en: A rainbow appeared after the rain.
The rainbow has seven colours.

mnemonic.tip: rain(雨)+bow(弓/弧),雨后天上的一道彩色弧就是彩虹。

examples.en: Take an umbrella; it might rain.
The wind broke my umbrella.

mnemonic.tip: umbrella 谐音"俺不理啦"——撑起伞,下再大的雨"俺也不理啦"。

examples.en: The heavy rain caused a flood.
Many homes were lost in the flood.
examples.zh: 许多房屋在洪水中被毁。

mnemonic.tip: flood 谐音"福辣的"——水漫上来"哗哗"淹一片就是洪水(oo读/ʌ/)。

examples.en: The drought lasted for months.
Crops die in a long drought.
examples.zh: 长期干旱会使庄稼枯死。

mnemonic.tip: drought 里藏着 dry(干),长期没雨、大地干裂就是干旱(gh不发音)。

examples.en: Autumn is my favourite season.
examples.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。

examples.en: There are four seasons in a year.

mnemonic.tip: season 谐音"西子"——春夏秋冬各有"姿"色,四时轮转就是季节。

examples.en: It's thirty degrees today.
The temperature fell below zero degrees.

mnemonic.tip: 温度计上一格一格(de-gree像"低-阶")的刻度就是"度"。

examples.en: A heatwave hit the city last week.
examples.zh: 上周热浪袭击了这座城市。

examples.en: People stayed indoors during the heatwave.
examples.zh: 酷暑期间人们待在室内。

mnemonic.tip: heat(热)+wave(浪),一波接一波的高温就是热浪。

examples.en: The sky is clear and blue.
Dark clouds filled the sky.

mnemonic.tip: sky 谐音"斯盖"——罩在头顶上的大盖子就是天空。

examples.en: The forecaster said it would snow.
Weather forecasters study the clouds.

mnemonic.tip: forecast(预报)+er(人),做天气预报的人就是预报员。

examples.en: The rain lasted all weekend.
Take your coat—it's going to rain.

mnemonic.tip: heavy rain 大雨，light rain 小雨——rain 既是名词也是动词。

examples.en: The mountains are covered in snow.
It snowed all night long.
The wind blew my hat off.
There isn't enough wind to fly the kite.

mnemonic.tip: 名词 wind /wɪnd/ 风；动词 wind /waɪnd/ 缠绕——同形不同音。

examples.en: Dark clouds mean rain is coming.
The plane flew above the clouds.

mnemonic.tip: 手机照片存在 cloud(云端)——天上的云和网络的云是同一个词。

examples.en: The storm broke three trees in our street.
examples.zh: 暴风雨刮断了我们街上三棵树。

examples.en: We stayed inside during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨期间我们待在室内。

mnemonic.tip: storm 一来，s(呼呼声)+torm——风雨雷电全都有。

examples.en: A thunderstorm hit the city in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午雷雨袭击了这座城市。

examples.en: My dog hides under the bed during thunderstorms.
examples.zh: 打雷下雨时我的狗躲到床底下。

mnemonic.tip: thunder(雷)+storm(暴风雨)→带雷的暴风雨→雷雨。

examples.en: The hurricane destroyed hundreds of houses.
examples.zh: 飓风摧毁了数百座房屋。

examples.en: People left the coast before the hurricane arrived.
examples.zh: 飓风来临前人们撤离了海岸。

mnemonic.tip: hurricane 谐音"呼里啃"——大风呼呼地把房子啃掉→飓风。

examples.en: The typhoon brought strong winds and heavy rain.
Schools were closed because of the typhoon.

mnemonic.tip: typhoon 音译"台风"——中英发音几乎一样。

examples.en: The tornado lifted a car into the air.
examples.zh: 龙卷风把一辆汽车卷上了天。

examples.en: Tornadoes are common in the middle of the USA.
examples.zh: 龙卷风在美国中部很常见。

mnemonic.tip: tornado 谐音"托奶多"——龙卷风力气大得能托起很多东西。

examples.en: The ship could not leave port in the gale.
A gale blew down the old fence last night.
examples.zh: 昨夜大风吹倒了旧栅栏。

mnemonic.tip: gale 谐音"盖了"——大风把屋顶都掀盖了。

examples.en: The hail was as big as golf balls.
examples.zh: 冰雹有高尔夫球那么大。

examples.en: It hailed for ten minutes this morning.

mnemonic.tip: hail 谐音"嗨哦"——天上砸下冰球，人人喊"嗨哦"快躲！

examples.en: The rain turned to sleet as it got colder.
examples.zh: 天转冷，雨变成了雨夹雪。

examples.en: Driving in sleet is dangerous.

mnemonic.tip: s(snow)+leet(像 rain 的尾音)→雪和雨混在一起→雨夹雪。

examples.en: A light drizzle fell all morning.
It's only drizzling—we don't need an umbrella.

mnemonic.tip: drizzle 谐音"滴一滴"——一滴一滴的小雨→毛毛雨。

examples.en: Morning mist covered the river.
The hills disappeared in the mist.

mnemonic.tip: mist 薄雾，fog 浓雾——mist 更轻更温柔。

examples.en: The grass was wet with morning dew.
Drops of dew shone in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 露珠在阳光下闪闪发亮。

mnemonic.tip: dew 谐音"滴呦"——清晨叶子上一滴呦亮的水珠→露水。

examples.en: The cat lay in the warm sunshine.
We had ten hours of sunshine yesterday.

mnemonic.tip: sun(太阳)+shine(照耀)→太阳照下来的光→阳光。

examples.en: Plants need sunlight to grow.
examples.zh: 植物需要阳光才能生长。

examples.en: The room is full of sunlight in the morning.

mnemonic.tip: sun(太阳)+light(光)→日光。

examples.en: Raindrops ran down the window.
I felt the first raindrop on my nose.
examples.zh: 我感觉第一滴雨落在了鼻子上。

mnemonic.tip: rain(雨)+drop(滴)→雨滴。

examples.en: Every snowflake has a different shape.
examples.zh: 每片雪花的形状都不同。

examples.en: Snowflakes landed softly on her hair.
examples.zh: 雪花轻轻落在她的头发上。

mnemonic.tip: snow(雪)+flake(薄片)→雪的小薄片→雪花。

examples.en: The children built a huge snowman in the garden.
examples.zh: 孩子们在花园里堆了个大雪人。

examples.en: Our snowman melted the next day.
examples.zh: 我们的雪人第二天就化了。

mnemonic.tip: snow(雪)+man(人)→雪人。

examples.en: The snowstorm closed all the roads.
examples.zh: 暴风雪封锁了所有道路。

examples.en: They were caught in a snowstorm on the mountain.
examples.zh: 他们在山上遭遇了暴风雪。

mnemonic.tip: snow(雪)+storm(风暴)→暴风雪。

examples.en: The blizzard lasted for two days.
You can't see anything in a blizzard.
examples.zh: 暴风雪里什么都看不见。

mnemonic.tip: blizzard 谐音"不理杂的"——暴风雪一来，什么杂事都顾不上了。

examples.en: This area gets very little rainfall in winter.
examples.zh: 这个地区冬天降雨量很少。

examples.en: Last month's rainfall broke the record.
examples.zh: 上个月的降雨量破了纪录。

mnemonic.tip: rain(雨)+fall(落下)→落下来的雨的总量→降雨量。

examples.en: We got soaked in a sudden downpour.
examples.zh: 一场突如其来的倾盆大雨把我们浇透了。

examples.en: The downpour stopped as quickly as it started.

mnemonic.tip: down(向下)+pour(倒水)→像从天上倒水一样→倾盆大雨。

examples.en: The little boy jumped in every puddle.
After the rain, the road was full of puddles.

mnemonic.tip: puddle 谐音"啪嘟"——踩进水坑"啪嘟"一声水花四溅。

examples.en: His boots were covered in mud.
The car got stuck in the mud.

mnemonic.tip: mud 谐音"抹的"——鞋上抹的全是泥。

examples.en: The lake was covered with thick ice.
Be careful—there's ice on the road.

mnemonic.tip: ice cream 冰淇淋、ice hockey 冰球——都从 ice 来。

examples.en: I can't sleep in this heat.
The summer heat lasted into September.
examples.zh: 夏天的高温一直持续到九月。

mnemonic.tip: heat 热——heater 加热器、heatwave 热浪都是它的家族。

examples.en: We enjoyed the warmth of the fire.
examples.zh: 我们享受着炉火的温暖。

examples.en: The warmth of the sun woke me up.
examples.zh: 太阳的暖意把我晒醒了。

mnemonic.tip: warm(温暖的)+th(名词后缀)→温暖；类比 true→truth。

examples.en: There's a chill in the air this morning.
examples.zh: 今早空气里有一丝寒意。

examples.en: The wind chilled us to the bone.

mnemonic.tip: chill 寒意；口语 chill out 放松——"冷静"下来。

examples.en: Let's sit in the shade of that tree.
examples.zh: 我们去那棵树的阴凉里坐吧。

examples.en: The temperature was 35 degrees even in the shade.

mnemonic.tip: shade 是躲太阳的阴凉，shadow 是影子——shade 更凉快。

examples.en: The weather report says it will snow tomorrow.
Dad watches the weather report every evening.
examples.zh: 爸爸每晚都看天气预报。

mnemonic.tip: weather(天气)+report(报告)→天气报告→天气预报。

examples.en: The weatherman promised sunshine for the weekend.
examples.zh: 天气预报员说周末有太阳。

examples.en: The weatherman got it wrong again!

mnemonic.tip: weather(天气)+man(人)→播天气的人。

examples.en: Flowers come out everywhere in spring.
Spring is the best season for a picnic.
examples.zh: 春天是野餐的最好季节。

mnemonic.tip: spring 一词三义：春天、泉水、弹簧——都有"往外冒"的活力。

examples.en: We go swimming every day in summer.
The summer holidays start in July.
The leaves turn red and gold in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天树叶变成红色和金色。

examples.en: Autumn is cool and dry here.

mnemonic.tip: 英式 autumn，美式 fall（叶子落下 fall）——PET 考英式。

examples.en: It often snows here in winter.
Bears sleep through the cold winter.
We stayed at home on the rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 下雨的下午我们待在家里。

examples.en: March is the rainiest month here.
examples.zh: 三月是这里雨最多的月份。

mnemonic.tip: rain(雨)+y(形容词后缀)→多雨的；类比 sun→sunny。

examples.en: The morning was cold and misty.
We could hardly see the bridge on the misty day.
examples.zh: 雾天我们几乎看不见那座桥。

mnemonic.tip: mist(薄雾)+y→有薄雾的。

examples.en: Drive slowly—the roads are icy.
An icy wind blew from the north.

mnemonic.tip: ice(冰)+y→结了冰的、冰冷的。

examples.en: The garden was white on the frosty morning.
It will be frosty tonight, so cover the plants.
examples.zh: 今晚有霜冻，把植物盖起来。

mnemonic.tip: frost(霜)+y→结霜的。

examples.en: Take off your muddy shoes at the door.
examples.zh: 在门口脱掉你那沾满泥的鞋。

examples.en: The path gets muddy after rain.

mnemonic.tip: mud(泥)+dy→满是泥的。

examples.en: The clothes are still damp—leave them outside.
examples.zh: 衣服还潮着——放外面晾着吧。

examples.en: The cave was dark and damp.

mnemonic.tip: damp 谐音"打不"——潮得火柴都打不着。

examples.en: The sky was grey and overcast all day.
examples.zh: 天空整天灰蒙蒙的阴着。

examples.en: It's overcast, but I don't think it will rain.
examples.zh: 天阴着，但我觉得不会下雨。

mnemonic.tip: over(整个上方)+cast(罩上)→云罩满天→阴天。

examples.en: The stars shone in the cloudless sky.
examples.zh: 星星在无云的夜空中闪烁。

examples.en: It was a perfect cloudless summer day.
examples.zh: 那是一个万里无云的完美夏日。

mnemonic.tip: cloud(云)+less(无)→一朵云都没有的。

examples.en: We got soaked walking home in the rain.
examples.zh: 我们冒雨走回家，浑身湿透。

examples.en: His shirt was soaked with sweat.
examples.zh: 他的衬衫被汗水浸透了。

mnemonic.tip: soaked 谐音"手可的"——湿得连手一拧都能出水。

examples.en: It was a dull, grey November day.
examples.zh: 那是十一月一个阴沉灰暗的日子。

examples.en: The film was so dull that I fell asleep.

mnemonic.tip: dull 谐音"打喽"——天阴人困，哈欠打喽。

examples.en: The weather was pleasant for the whole trip.
examples.zh: 整个旅途天气都很宜人。

examples.en: A pleasant breeze came in from the sea.

mnemonic.tip: please(使高兴)+ant→让人高兴的→宜人的。

examples.en: Severe weather closed the airport.
examples.zh: 恶劣天气导致机场关闭。

examples.en: The winter was more severe than usual.
examples.zh: 这个冬天比往常更严酷。

mnemonic.tip: severe 谐音"死危啊"——恶劣天气死危啊，别出门。

examples.en: Extreme heat is dangerous for old people.
examples.zh: 极端高温对老人很危险。

examples.en: The desert has extreme temperatures day and night.

mnemonic.tip: extreme 站在最外(ex)端→极端的；extreme sports 极限运动。

examples.en: Tropical islands are warm all year round.
A tropical storm is coming towards the coast.
examples.zh: 一场热带风暴正逼近海岸。

mnemonic.tip: tropical 谐音"戳皮卡"——热带太阳毒得能戳穿皮卡。

examples.en: It was minus ten degrees last night.
Ten minus three is seven.

mnemonic.tip: minus 减号(-)——温度前加 minus 就是零下。

examples.en: It's too hot to play outside at noon.
examples.zh: 中午太热，没法在外面玩。

examples.en: Be careful—the soup is very hot.

mnemonic.tip: hot 热+烫+辣三义——hot water 热水，hot food 辣的食物。

examples.en: The weather is getting warmer every day.
Come in and warm yourself by the fire.

mnemonic.tip: warm 不冷不烫刚刚好——warm-hearted 热心肠。

examples.en: The evenings are cool in the mountains.
Let the cake cool before you cut it.

mnemonic.tip: cool 凉爽；口语"酷"也是它——That's cool!

examples.en: The icy pavement is very slippery.
Careful, the wet floor is slippery!

mnemonic.tip: slip(滑倒)+pery→容易让人滑倒的。

examples.en: British weather is famously changeable.
Spring weather is changeable—bring a jacket.
examples.zh: 春天天气多变——带件外套。

mnemonic.tip: change(变化)+able(能)→说变就变的→多变的。

examples.en: A cold wind was blowing from the east.
The wind blew the leaves across the garden.

mnemonic.tip: blow-blew-blown——风吹、吹气球、吹蜡烛都用它。

examples.en: The sun shone brightly all day.
examples.zh: 太阳整天明晃晃地照着。

examples.en: Her eyes shone with excitement.
examples.zh: 她的眼睛闪着兴奋的光。

mnemonic.tip: shine-shone-shone——sunshine 里就藏着 shine。

examples.en: The snow began to thaw in the spring sunshine.
examples.zh: 积雪在春日阳光下开始融化。

examples.en: Take the meat out to thaw before cooking.
examples.zh: 做饭前把肉拿出来解冻。

mnemonic.tip: thaw 谐音"烧"——像被太阳烧化了→解冻。

examples.en: The lake freezes over every January.
examples.zh: 这个湖每年一月全面封冻。

examples.en: The pond froze over and we went skating.
examples.zh: 池塘结冰了，我们去滑冰。

mnemonic.tip: freeze(结冰)+over(整个)→整个冻上→封冻。

examples.en: The rain should clear up by lunchtime.
If it clears up, we'll go to the beach.
examples.zh: 要是放晴，我们就去海滩。

mnemonic.tip: clear(晴朗)+up→天空亮起来→放晴。

examples.en: It usually cools down after a thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 雷雨过后通常会凉快下来。

examples.en: Have some water and cool down a bit.

mnemonic.tip: cool(凉)+down(下来)→温度降下来。

examples.en: The wind died down in the evening.
We waited for the storm to die down.

mnemonic.tip: die(消亡)+down(下去)→风声雨声慢慢"死"下去→减弱。

examples.en: It poured down all afternoon.
Suddenly it started pouring down.

mnemonic.tip: pour(倒水)+down→雨像倒下来一样→倾盆大雨。

examples.en: Run, or we'll get wet!
I forgot my umbrella and got wet through.
The children threw snowballs at each other.
We had a snowball fight after school.

mnemonic.tip: snow(雪)+ball(球)→雪球；snowball fight 打雪仗。

examples.en: We took shelter from the rain under a bridge.
The hut sheltered us from the storm.
examples.zh: 小屋为我们挡住了暴风雨。

mnemonic.tip: shelter 谐音"歇塔"——雨来了到塔下歇一歇→躲避处。

examples.en: A gust of wind blew the door shut.
examples.zh: 一阵狂风把门吹关上了。

examples.en: Strong gusts made cycling difficult.
examples.zh: 阵阵狂风让骑车变得困难。

mnemonic.tip: gust 谐音"刮死它"——一阵狂风差点把伞刮死。

examples.en: Water boils at 100 degrees centigrade.
The temperature dropped to five degrees centigrade.

mnemonic.tip: centi(百)+grade(刻度)→分成一百格的温度计→摄氏。
